newsitem.title: USA: Metromail adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Metromail adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Metromail Corp said Monday its board of directors approved a shareholder rights plan designed to discourage hostile takeover attempts.
A company spokesman said the move is not a response to a known takeover threat.

The rights would become exercisable only if a single investor buys, or announces a tender offer to buy, 15 percent or more of Metromail's common stock, the company said. The threshhold is 20 percent in the case of certain transferees of R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co, Metromail said.
Metromail provides database marketing and reference products and services.
Its shares were trading down 1/8 Monday at 17-7/8.
